description_en: Creates a workflow. By default, the created workflow is disabled. After you update the directed acyclic graph (DAG) of the workflow, you must manually or call the corresponding operation to enable the workflow. You can call this operation only in the professional edition
description_zh: 创建工作流，默认禁用状态，更新完DAG后，需要手动或者通过API启动用工作流，只有专业版才支持
kebab_example: aliyun schedulerx2 create-workflow --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --namespace adcfc35d-e2fe-4fe9-bbaa-20e90ffc0000 --group-id testSchedulerx.defaultGroup --name helloworld --time-type 1 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateWorkflow

parameters.help_en: The namespace ID. You can obtain the namespace ID on the Namespace page in the SchedulerX console
parameters.help_zh: 命名空间ID，在控制台的命名空间页面中获取
parameters.name: namespace

parameters.help_en: The source of the namespace. This parameter is required only for a special third party
parameters.help_zh: 特殊第三方才需要填写
parameters.name: namespace_source

parameters.help_en: The application group ID. You can obtain the ID on the Application Management page in the SchedulerX console
parameters.help_zh: 应用分组ID，在控制台的应用管理页面中获取
parameters.name: group_id

parameters.help_en:
The method that is used to specify the time. Valid values:

1: cron
100: api
parameters.help_zh:
时间类型，目前支持以下几种时间类型：
cron：1
api：100
parameters.name: time_type

parameters.help_en:
The time expression. You can set the time expression based on the selected method that is used to specify time.

If you set the TimeType parameter to cron, you need to enter a standard cron expression. Online verification is supported.
If you set the TimeType parameter to api, no time expression is required
parameters.help_zh:
时间表达式，根据选择的时间类型设置时间表达式。

cron：填写标准的cron表达式，支持在线验证。
api：无时间表达式
parameters.name: time_expression

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of workflow instances that can be run at the same time. Default value: 1. The value 1 indicates that only one workflow instance is allowed. In this case, if the triggered workflow instance is still ongoing, no more workflow instances can be triggered even the time to schedule the next workflow arrives
parameters.help_zh: 最大同时运行工作流实例数量，默认值为1，即上次触发没有运行结束，即使到了运行时刻也不会进行下次触发
parameters.name: max_concurrency

Data.description_en: The data that was returned for the request

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the workflow was created. Valid values:

true
false
Success.description_zh:
创建工作流是否成功。取值如下：

true：创建工作流成功。
false：创建工作流失败
